params.description: Key-name of the alarms; accepts multiple values separated by comma

params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

items.docs: Count alarms for a site, optionally grouped by the `distinct` field and filtered by time range. Use [Count Org Alarms](/#operations/countOrgAlarms) to count alarms across the organization.

params.name: group
params.description: Alarm group used to filter alarm results. enum: `certificate_expiry`, `infrastructure`, `marvis`, `security`. The `marvis` group is used to retrieve AI-driven network issue detections. Known Marvis alarm types include: `bad_cable`, `bad_wan_uplink`, `dns_failure`, `arp_failure`, `auth_failure`, `dhcp_failure`, `missing_vlan`, `negotiation_mismatch`, `port_flap`. Results include resolution status (`status`, `resolved_time`) and affected entity details.

params.name: severity
params.description: Alarm severity used to filter results. enum: `critical`, `info`, `warn`

params.name: type
params.description: Filter alarms by alarm type. Accepts multiple values separated by comma. Use [List Alarm Definitions](/#operations/listAlarmDefinitions) to get the list of possible alarm types

params.name: ack_admin_name
params.description: Name of the admins who have acked the alarms; accepts multiple values separated by comma

params.name: acked
params.description: Filter alarm results by whether the alarm has been acknowledged

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`

params.name: sort
params.description: On which field the list should be sorted, -prefix represents DESC order

params.name: search_after
params.description: Pagination cursor for retrieving subsequent pages of results. This value is automatically populated by Mist in the `next` URL from the previous response and should not be manually constructed.

items.docs: Search alarms for a site with filters for alarm group, severity, type, acknowledgement state, acknowledgement admin, and time range. Use [Search Org Alarms](/#operations/searchOrgAlarms) to search alarms across the organization.
